description: A generator's body is lazy but its parameter list is eager, so a throwing default escapes at the call — the same rule as any other function kind, with no generator special case.

diagnostics.message: Call to `counter` escapes this `@nothrow` function: its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or make `counter` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
